notes.title: Update #6 - Patch v0.492 LIVE! Stats, Progression, Rewards, and More
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26619883/ecf608a04a5fa44a75b74d059977ac6916b8f6b4.jpg[/img]

This patch relied heavily on there being a back-end involved. Q/A for this took the longest which is why this update took so long. Before this I didn't have much knowledge on this topic so there may still be some bugs. Pls post about any bugs you do find, that will help me to polish these up.
Enjoy the features below:

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Player Stats.
[*]Cloud Saving.
[*]Progression.
[*]Daily/Weekly Challenges and Rewards.
[*]Support for Razer Chroma peripherals.
[*]Balanced gameplay.
[*]New UI.
[*]More Twitch play features.
[*]In-game Feedback form.
[*]In-game messages from the developer.
[*]Supporter credits.
[*]Support for user generated content.
[*]Volume Sliders!!!
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26619883/a90370ea84e8eaa54b29dd54fcc474b311ad0c8b.gif[/img]

For a more detailed list of features and fixes, read the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/471400/discussions/3/1700541698692336242/][b]changelist[/b][/url].

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
The next update will include some more content made by myself and select Kickstarter supporters. Be on the lookout for new weapons, user generated content and enemies, bosses and levels!

As always, post any bugs or issues you find in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/471400/discussions/1/][b] Bugs/Issues[/b][/url] discussion, thanks!

[u]Sorob[/u] ːB1ː

notes.title: Update #5 Twitch Integration & Pets! Patch v0.465 LIVE!
notes.content:
I wanted to inform everyone that the game is still getting regular updates, but I didn't know that my patch notes were not showing on the front page (making it look like there were no new updates), so here is the most recent patch notes to look at. Updates are still coming every month so look out!

[h1]Updates/Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Twitch Chat integration.
[*]Added Twitch Chat voting. Players can now stream this game to their own Twitch channel and invite viewers in the chat to type commands to vote for certain events to occur in the streamer's game. For example, you could vote to have all enemy health to be doubled or spawn a health crate near the player!
[*]Added more pet followers (15 in all) to help you on your journey!
[*]More level art and character sprite changes.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed self spawning enemies spawning too many times.
[*]Hamburger traps not operating correctly. They now shoot flames when players are nearby.
[*]Fixed bounce code for certain weapons.
[*]Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]

As always, post any bugs or issues you find in the [b] "Bugs/Issues" [/b] discussion, thanks!

[u]Sorob[/u] ːB1ː

notes.title: PATCH v0.441 Live!!!
notes.content:
Just a quick patch with bug fixes for mostly Mac and Linux platforms.

Check the Change-list for more info: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/471400/discussions/3/135512555422828772/] Change-List v0.441 [/url]

The next small patch will add some AI controlled companions to explore dimensions and loot aliens with! These will be swapped out for human controlled players as they join in.

The aim will be to have these AI companions be discovered and freed in the levels by players. They will act as unlocking new character skins as well as being able to follow and fight with you instantly!

Sorob ːB1ː

notes.title: UPDATE v0.440 Released!!!
notes.content:
This week's update adds some quality of life additions to mouse controls in the Options Menu and overall gameplay.

This is geared towards tightening up gameplay and helping to keep track of player characters amidst the action.

For that reason, a big addition is to the camera which can now auto zoom on the action or be toggled by the player to either see more of the level or focus in on what you are attacking.

As requested by a forum poster, the mouse reticle can now move outside the screen which helps if your character is against the edge. You can also set how the camera follows the reticle as well as how the reticle moves in relation to the character.

Check the Change-list for more info: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/471400/discussions/3/135512305398932468/] Change-List v0.440 [/url]

Next update will continue to add more fixes and gameplay updates before going on to the next content patch, stay tuned!

Sorob ːB1ː
